text: I eventually told my partner. She was angry but we got through it. A few sessions with a counsellor about the guilt.

Ich habe eine Traumatherapie gemacht, in der wir mit Imaginationsübungen gearbeitet haben. Das hat mir geholfen, das Bild zu verändern. Meditieren mache ich jetzt mit offenen Augen. Die Leitung des Retreats hat sich nie gemeldet, obwohl ich ihnen geschrieben habe.

The women's shelter was the first help. They had a counsellor who specialised in domestic violence, and she helped me understand what had been happening in my marriage. Later I started trauma therapy, which I've been doing for two years now. We've worked on the flashbacks and the dissociation. I also see a psychiatrist and take an antidepressant.

My kids and I did family therapy for a while, which helped them too.

A support group for survivors of domestic abuse has been very important. Hearing other women's stories, I've stopped blaming myself so much.

Running and yoga help me feel at home in my body again.

The divorce and the court case about the children were re-traumatising. Having to see him in court brought back all the flashbacks.

I'm much better now. I've rebuilt a life. But I still freeze when someone moves suddenly near me.
Ich habe viel darüber geschrieben und mit Freunden gesprochen, die Erfahrung mit Psychedelika haben.

I saw a therapist for a few months who helped me with the panic. Breathing exercises were tricky because focusing on my breath triggered me, so we did grounding with the senses instead. I'm mostly okay now.

I told my GP, who referred me to an early intervention service for psychosis. They assessed me and decided it wasn't psychosis but anxiety with some unusual experiences after drug use. I had a course of CBT with them, which was excellent. They taught me to test the 'messages' against evidence. I was also prescribed a low dose of an antipsychotic for a few months, which I came off. I slowly started playing music again, with the band. Music feels safe again now.

Ich habe nach meiner Rückkehr eine Therapie begonnen, die mir sehr geholfen hat. Wir haben an der Angst vor Dunkelheit und vor Männergruppen gearbeitet. Außerdem habe ich einen Selbstverteidigungskurs gemacht, der mir das Gefühl gegeben hat, nicht mehr so hilflos zu sein. Ich habe der älteren Frau einen Brief geschrieben, um mich zu bedanken.

After coming home I saw my GP and a tropical medicine specialist, who checked me physically. Then a psychologist who helped me make peace with the memory gaps. That was hard, because there was nothing to remember, only to accept not knowing. I was on an SSRI for a year. I spoke to other participants from that ceremony by email, which helped me reconstruct some of what happened, though some of what they told me made me feel worse. I've written a warning about that retreat on several forums. Time has helped the most.
Bisher nichts Besonderes. Ich meide Höhen.
Talked to my sister, made new friends.
